Description.DefaultText: Indirectly shows how well-hydrated you are. Leads to stress, a lower wellbeing and eventual dehydration. Excessive drinking increases the frequency of your need to urinate.

Description.en: Indirectly shows how well-hydrated you are. Leads to stress, a lower wellbeing and eventual dehydration. Excessive drinking increases the frequency of your need to urinate.
